# Audio To Text Transcription

> Chrome extension that converts audio and video to text, powered by AI. Upload files or record from microphone/browser tab. Includes a free plan and supports 90+ transcription languages. Edit transcripts, copy text, or download as TXT.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://audio-to-text-transcription.com/): Features, how it works, FAQ, and demo
- [Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/audio-to-text-transcription/pkfoaaglghblmjjjpbniicjcpehfbmgd): Install the extension
